faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Programme Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the TISS Programme Manager position is 23 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Com or MBA (Finance) degree. Additionally, a minimum of 2 years of experience in accounts and finance, with project accounting experience being preferred, is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the TISS Programme Manager position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Programme Manager post is 35 years. The institute may consider relaxing the age limit based on relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Programme Manager role at TISS?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Programme Manager position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Programme Manager post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Programme Manager post announced by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the TISS Programme Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST candidates. Women candidates are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the TISS Programme Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, followed by a Personal Interaction, and a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The Programme Manager position at TISS is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Telangana apply for this post?
faq.answer: The notification mentions Hyderabad, Telangana as the location. While the official notification should be checked for specific domicile requirements, generally, candidates from all over India are eligible to apply for government jobs unless otherwise specified.
